allowed_actions.name: navigate
allowed_actions.description: Select a named destination or a relative offset; the executor plans the path.

subtypes.name: entity
subtypes.description: Navigate to the exact entity reference supplied by the observation, or to a known room_name anchor. Use this action to approach the same target before a nearby interaction when needed.

subtypes.name: relative
subtypes.description: Select a destination relative to the heading at execution start. distance must be a finite number greater than 0, in meters. forward and backward follow that axis; left and right are perpendicular; front_left and front_right are 45 degrees left and right of forward. The navigation controller determines the path and final heading.

parameters.direction: forward | left | right | backward | front_left | front_right

allowed_actions.name: instruct_civilian
allowed_actions.description: Issue an instruction to nearby civilians from the current position. This action does not navigate and takes no target parameter. For follow, apply the approximately 2-meter baseline proximity guideline; use follower feedback to assess the reported relationship.

subtypes.name: follow
subtypes.description: Ask nearby civilians to follow. The current follower list reports all followers; newly_following_npcs identifies additions to the previous report.

subtypes.name: stop_following
subtypes.description: Send a stop-following request. A true return value means success and clears the current cached follower list; false means failure.

allowed_actions.name: wait
allowed_actions.description: Wait in place for 10 seconds. No subtype or duration parameter. The environment keeps evolving, and the final observation takes additional time. Output {"name": "wait", "parameters": {}}.

allowed_actions.name: explore
allowed_actions.description: Run the shared exploration macro for a known room with supported geometry. The executor selects the route, which normally ends at its loop start. Completion reports route traversal; coverage and room safety require observation evidence. Output {"name": "explore", "parameters": {"room": "<room_name>"}}.
